derived_health_proxy: Measured capacitance divided by public2200uF, with reversible case-temperature compensation and fixed constant shift0.8; noisy proxy, never hidden D or endpoint EOL/time.
derived_stress_proxy: present observed losses/rated paths/noisy airflow/current commands; no ageing or Reference continuation and no future measurement
label_semantics: point labels only where termination==1; pilot numeric field otherwise contains elapsed-to-exit lower bound and is never supervised. Formal export uses nullable Reference target, separate observed flag/lower bound/reason.
